title: Birthday Gift
text:
We loved our trip on a helicopter over Barcelona’s coastline. 
It was a beautiful day with clear blue skies and we had a smooth trip above the crystal waters. 
I booked this as a gift for my partner’s birthday and he loved every minute of it. 
We were on a cruise which docked in Barcelona, the company was located a short ten minutes walk from the terminal. Communication was great, they confirmed the time of flying the day before, we simply docked, walked along, we were weighed, shown a safety video and then called for our flight.

title: The best
text:
I had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend it to everyone. The staff was extremely friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. Together with my brother, we managed to see a large part of Barcelona in a short time.

It is truly one of the activities that everyone who plans to visit Barcelona should try. The explanations were detailed and very interesting, and the pilot was incredibly kind and hospitable. Overall, it was a fantastic experience that I will always remember.

title: A Sky-High Barcelona Memory!
text:
Our very first helicopter ride — and what an unforgettable experience! We went as a family, a little nervous but so excited, and the moment we lifted off, Barcelona opened up beneath us like a living postcard.

Seeing the Sagrada Família, the stadium, and the sparkling coastline from above was nothing short of magical. Even though the flight was just 12 minutes, it felt like a highlight reel of the city’s greatest treasures.

“From takeoff to touchdown, it was pure wow!”
“Barcelona looks even better with a sky-high upgrade!”

The whole ride left us smiling, amazed, and already wanting to do it
